# awesome-ai-prompts

> A curated list of copy-paste AI coding-agent prompts for developers: disciplined workflows that verify, don't guess.

144 prompts across 14 categories, generated from the prompt files in github.com/shauryagangrade/awesome-ai-prompts (MIT licensed). Each prompt page carries the full prompt block ready to paste into an AI coding agent.

## Site

- [All prompts on one page](https://awesome-ai-prompts.vercel.app/): the full catalog with a mini-TOC and one-click copy buttons
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/shauryagangrade/awesome-ai-prompts): source of truth for every prompt, contributions welcome

- [a-a-p-contributing](https://awesome-ai-prompts.vercel.app/category/a-a-p-contributing): 6 prompts

- [code-review](https://awesome-ai-prompts.vercel.app/category/code-review): 6 prompts
- [core-coding](https://awesome-ai-prompts.vercel.app/category/core-coding): 20 prompts
- [data-ai](https://awesome-ai-prompts.vercel.app/category/data-ai): 13 prompts

- [docs-delivery](https://awesome-ai-prompts.vercel.app/category/docs-delivery): 7 prompts
